question: Which approach yields useful performance evidence?
options: Repeat a representative workload, measure it, verify results, and compare under the same conditions
Time each implementation once and pick the smaller number without checking results
Optimize by counting lines of code only
Assume table allocation dominates every program
answer_key: Repeat a representative workload, measure it, verify results, and compare under the same conditions
explanation: Repeatable benchmarking and correctness checks help reduce noisy conclusions. os.clock measures CPU time; elapsed-time needs may require a host timer.
